title: ARG Circuit Breaker Event
description:
Emitted by the FinancialCircuitBreaker on every state transition and threshold crossing. One event per trip, per warn, per recovery. Consumed by the telemetry pipeline and downstream alerting systems.

This schema documents the BreakerEvent dataclass in circuit_breaker.py. Every field here maps 1:1 to a field on that class.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event. Generated by the circuit breaker at emission time.

wallet_id.description: The wallet instance this event relates to.

execution_tree_id.description: Agent execution tree bound to the wallet at the time of this event.

trigger_signal.description: The specific signal that caused this state transition or threshold crossing.

previous_state.description: Circuit breaker state before this event.

new_state.description: Circuit breaker state after this event.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event occurred.

call_count_in_window.description: Number of API calls in the sliding window at the moment the event fired.

calls_per_minute_rate.description: Calculated call rate (calls/minute) at the moment the event fired. Derived from the sliding window timestamps.

unique_endpoints_in_window.description: Number of distinct endpoints called within the sliding window. High values indicate breadth fan-out; low values with high call count indicate depth fan-out.

repeated_endpoint_pattern.description: True when a single endpoint accounts for >= depth_fanout_threshold fraction of calls in the window. Indicates a depth fan-out or recursive loop.

mission_utilization_percent.description: Wallet utilization (tokens consumed / token limit * 100) at the moment the event fired. Used to determine how much budget was preserved by an early trip.

detail.description: Optional freeform detail block for implementation-specific diagnostic data. Not part of the guaranteed contract.
